requirements.summary: Add a download button in the Vault Publishing Controls that appears after a successful IPFS upload to Pinata, allowing users to retrieve and download the uploaded files (images and metadata JSON) from Pinata
acceptanceCriteria: Download button is visible only after a successful Pinata upload completes
Button triggers download of the files that were uploaded to Pinata (NFT images and metadata)
Existing upload functionality and UI remain unchanged
Button integrates seamlessly with the current VaultPublishingControls component design

file_operations.description: Add a download button that appears after successful Pinata upload. Store the uploaded file CIDs from the uploadToIPFS response in component state. Add a handler function that fetches files from Pinata using the stored CIDs and triggers browser downloads for each file. Position the button next to the existing upload controls, visible only when uploadStatus is 'complete' and CIDs are available. Maintain all existing upload logic, UI styling, and state management without modification.

Add a utility function to download files from Pinata given a CID and filename. The function should construct the Pinata gateway URL, fetch the file content, create a blob, and trigger a browser download using an anchor element with the download attribute. Handle errors gracefully and return success/failure status.
